test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 01 Dec, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/492163713cc8bba353683c762b3de615d6f657252335b0816f6cf5bc82651ddb.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series → All the elements shift to the opposite side subsequently.

2) Second box series → The whole box rotate 90º anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9048df1f75f8e97efd7965448cc1df6506bf46b8389fdc2bbde92d29acf02099.png] 

Thus, the final series is: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5e5aab35c22e4edc3bec9f110588bc82c139ebee11af743d472fbb36fc927ae.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c4dfd79c66af74b6246d3d9757f096a7dc846342ccb41e1c6507ddf9228a62e.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
